codeReview.summary: Pass. Commit `f961d19` satisfies VAL-FOUND-004: `pino` and `pino-pretty` are present in `server/package.json`, `server/shared/logger.ts` exports a production/dev-configured pino instance, the reviewed commit removes `console.log/error/warn` usage from `server/**/*.ts` (excluding tests), and `server/index.ts` adds HTTP request logging with request id, method, URL, status, and duration. One non-blocking observability gap remains: the request-logging middleware is mounted after `express.json()`, so malformed JSON requests bypass the logger and never receive `req.id`.

issues.description: `express.json()` runs before the request-logging middleware, so requests rejected by the JSON parser never receive `req.id` and are missing from the HTTP request log. Mount the request logger before body parsing if the intent is to log every HTTP request, including malformed JSON requests.
